care.shoes: Air out after wearing; keep out of direct sun. Wipe dirt off with a damp cloth. Store in a cloth bag to keep the shape.
care.pointe: Dry in an airy place after every class so the shank & box don't soften too quickly. Never machine wash.
care.apparel: Hand wash cold, do not wring, line dry. Do not iron directly.
care.tights: Hand wash cold in a laundry bag, line dry.

shippingInfo: Shipped from our Jakarta warehouse across Java. Ready items ship in 1–2 business days; instant & same-day delivery available in Greater Jakarta. Shipping is calculated at checkout.
paymentInfo: Pay in full, digitally: QRIS, e-wallets (GoPay, OVO, DANA, ShopeePay), Virtual Account (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI, Permata) or credit/debit card.
